label: Pocket 1: Three Missiles

trigger.text: Open when three missiles are used on the same combat roll.
trigger.rulebook: POCKET 1: Open as soon as 3 Missiles are used during the same combat roll. Open this pocket as soon as the third missile is played and BEFORE resolving combat. The 3 Missiles can be played by the same person or multiple people. If there are multiple players trying to play the third Missile at the same time, priority as to who plays the third Missile goes to the attacker, then the defender, then each player clockwise around the table from the attacker. This will be opened in the middle of a game.

warProgresses.title: The War Progresses: Three Missiles (1)
warProgresses.text:
The Unthinkable has happened. The factions pushed the war until someone unleashed a nuclear device. There will be consequences.

Place the Fallout Zone reference sticker onto the gameboard now.

sticker.text: Remove half your troops (round up) when entering this territory. If you control this territory at the end of your turn, remove one troop from it.

warProgresses.title: The War Progresses: Three Missiles (2)
warProgresses.text:
The player that played the third missile gets to choose whether it is the attacking or defending territory has been nuked and changed forever.

Place the Fallout Zone mark on the chosen territory. This mark covers any city and scar on the territory. Find the territory card for the fallout territory and DESTROY it, even if it is currently in a player's hand. Reshuffle the territory deck.

warProgresses.title: The War Progresses: Three Missiles (3)
warProgresses.text:
Remove the 1, 2, or 3 attacking troops and the 1, or 2 defending troops in the battle. Then, remove all troops and DEMOLISH any HQ in the fallout territory.

Each territory connected to the fallout territory by land loses 1 die worth of troops. If a player is knocked out or eliminated, he discards any resource cards.

Put the 8 Mutant Event Cards aside. They will go into (or create) the event deck for the next game.

warProgresses.title: The War Progresses: Three Missiles (4)
warProgresses.text: Place the 'Bringer of Nuclear Fire' scar on the faction card that played the third missile, just below the faction's name.

warProgresses.title: The War Progresses: Three Missiles (5)
warProgresses.text:
Starting next game there will be a mutant faction, who want revenge, especially against the Bringer of Nuclear Fire. Mutants are drafted like any other faction but have a unique way of evolving (through their event cards). Their faction card includes a private mission (in red) that can earn them one Red Star token once per game.

Do not scratch off the covered area on the mutant faction until instructed.

warProgresses.title: The War Progresses: Three Missiles (6)
warProgresses.text:
After the devastation of the nuclear attack, the other factions begin researching alternative weapons. From that research, comes Missile Powers, included in this pack.

These powers can be activated by discarding a Missile. Each faction with an empty brown slot will get one Missile power, although not at the same time. See the Missile rules in this pack for more info.

powers.name: EMP
powers.text: Activate before a combat roll. Dice rolled for combat in that territory can't be modified for the rest of the turn.

powers.name: Interference
powers.text: Activate as a player draws a resource card. That card cannot be drawn. The player can draw any other eligible card.

powers.name: Recon
powers.text: Activate before you would draw a coin card. You may take any one face up territory card instead.

powers.name: Bad Intel
powers.text: Activate at the start of another player's turn. Deny that player one continent bonus, your choice.

powers.name: Rally
powers.text: Activate at the start of your turn. Place 2 troops in every HQ you control.

powers.name: Bringer of Nuclear Fire
powers.text: At the start of the game, the Bringer of Nuclear Fire faction receives 2 Missile tokens as long as the mutant faction is also playing. These are in addition to any tokens received by the player.

powers.name: Mutants: Starting Power
powers.text: You don't lose troops in the fallout territory or from Mutant Event Cards

powers.name: Mutants: Private Mission
powers.text: Controlling all bio-hazard territories and the fallout territory earns you 1 Red Star

powers.name: Mutants: Revenge
powers.text: When attacking the Bringer of Nuclear Fire's troops, you may re-roll 1's on all attack dice until they are no longer 1's

powers.name: Mutants: Scar Reversal
powers.text: Bio-hazard and mercenary scar effects are reversed for you

stickers.name: Fallout Zone mark
stickers.text: Place the Fallout Zone mark on the chosen territory. This mark covers any city and scar on the territory. Find the territory card for the fallout territory and DESTROY it, even if it is currently in a player's hand. Reshuffle the territory deck.

events.name: Agent of Chaos
events.text:
If no human faction has a continent bonus, the mutant faction collects one red star token.

DISCARD this card.

events.name: Fallout
events.text:
Roll 1 die for each territory connected to the fallout territory by land and remove that many troops from it.

DESTROY this card.

events.name: The Mutants Evolve
events.text:
Do the mutants evolve OFFENSIVELY or DEFENSIVELY?

The mutant player chooses and scratches off his choice. Keep this card in the game box. Once both Mutants Evolve cards have been scratched, scratch off the box on the mutant faction card that matches the code to reveal the mutant's evolved power.

[Scratch-off boxes: OFFENSIVE, DEFENSIVE]

events.name: The Mutants Evolve
events.text:
What evolves on the mutants: their BODIES or their BRAINS?

The mutant player chooses and scratches off his choice. Keep this card in the game box. Once both Mutants Evolve cards have been scratched, scratch off the box on the mutant faction card that matches the code to reveal the mutant's evolved power.

[Scratch-off boxes: BODIES, BRAINS]

rules.title: Missile Power Rules: Missile Powers
rules.text: Missile Powers: A faction with an empty brown slot gains a Missile power (player's choice) the next time it earns a red star token during a game (starting tokens do not count). Once per turn, you may discard 1 Missile to use the power. Players may still use Missiles in combat.

rules.text: Bringer of Nuclear Fire: At the start of the game, the Bringer of Nuclear Fire faction receives 2 Missile tokens as long as the mutant faction is also playing. These are in addition to any tokens received by the player.

rules.inferredFrom: Card-code order (see missile_power_rules); 'Part 1' and 'Part 2' take adjacent boxes.
rules.title: Fallout Territory Rules: Part 1
rules.text:
FALLOUT TERRITORY Whenever a faction expands into, or conquers, the fallout territory, it immediately loses half its troops (round up).

This does not affect troops you are sending into battle while fighting for the territory, only the troops you eventually send into the territory when/if you conquer it.

rules.title: Fallout Territory Rules: Part 2
rules.text:
You cannot place troops into nor maneuver troops through the fallout territory. Remove 1 troop from the fallout territory at the end of your turn if you control it.

Mutants are unaffected by the fallout territory rules, and should treat it like a bio-hazard territory.

Note: The fallout territory can no longer be marked, scarred, or modified in any way.

marks.name: Fallout Zone
marks.text: Remove half your troops (round up) when entering this territory. If you control this territory at the end of your turn, remove one troop from it.

secretPowers.name: Mass Hypnosis
secretPowers.text: When turning in cards, you may pick one of those territories. Until the beginning of your next turn, that territory cannot be attacked.

secretPowers.name: Unstable Cloning
secretPowers.text: When defending, if you roll natural doubles, add 1 additional defending troop to the territory if you still own it after the battle.

secretPowers.name: Mindshackle
secretPowers.text: After collecting a resource card, you may trade it for a random card from the hand of a player whose territory you conquered this turn.

secretPowers.name: Unnatural Strength
secretPowers.text: When attacking, your 6's beat the defender's 6's.
